build_mel_spectrogram: build a module that computes Mel-filterbank spectrograms from raw audio waveforms using GemaxMelFilterbank
build_conformer_encoder: build a Conformer audio encoder stack with configurable layers, attention heads, and model dimensions
build_subsampling_block: build a subsampling block that reduces audio sequence length via strided convolutions and LayerNorm
build_local_attention: build a local dot-product attention module with Transformer-XL relative position embeddings and causal masking
build_conformer_layer: build a single Conformer layer combining FFN, self-attention, lightweight convolution, and residual connections
